sources.title: See each claim; this file's claims carry their own sources.

note: Claims for polities the boundary source does not name in any year, so there is nothing to carry from a neighbouring snapshot and an extent has to be stated.

claims.note: The Swahili coast article names Sofala, Kilwa, Mombasa, Gede and Pate among its towns. The source draws none of them in any year. The claim is the coastal strip and islands, with the inland limit computed one degree west of the real coastline rather than drawn by hand, because these were ports with a shallow hinterland. Kilwa Kisiwani itself is too small an island to appear in Natural Earth land, so the island seat is not drawn even here.
